briefing: Field Report from Agent Polaris: The DOJ has charged 15 people in a $90 million Medicaid fraud scheme in Minnesota. This is an 'unprecedented' case according to the DOJ. Additionally, the 'mastermind' of the $250M Feeding Our Future fraud was sentenced to 41 years in prison. Minnesota Medicaid funds won't be released until spending is justified, suggesting potential issues with fund management. These cases have sparked scrutiny of Minnesota officials. Next steps include investigating the role of officials in these cases and tracking any new developments.
